segments.summary: Reviewed every core line for PS-123 through PS-127 and the AutonomyCeilingReceipt addendum. Exact behavior is strong on empty-by-default visualizer libraries, notification send authority, provider credential ownership, host discovery versus execution, blocked outcomes, and model-independent autonomy enforcement. Adversarial review found open nonce replay, remote-delivery partial-failure, upstream provenance, approval freshness, and check-to-dispatch atomicity contracts.

Reviewed every core line for PS-131, PS-128, PS-129, PS-130, and the following deferred-repair text covering durable section aliases, atomic TOML persistence and conflicts, permission UI commands and states, domain-sensitive classes, approval-record fields, and reason-code transitions. Exact behavior unifies consent consumers, makes egress policy explicit, invalidates changed-command retries, and forbids reusable CLI privilege. Adversarial review found optional snapshot ambiguity, incomplete per-hop SSRF invariants, undefined command canonicalization, and missing behavioral oracles for PS-130.
